method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Built lists 8 pages plus Classic editor; reference lists 11 (Password generator, Interface, History & backups, External tools, Advanced are missing as pages).
Icon, label, description, control and provenance line; provenance exceeds the reference.
M3 switch anatomy; built uses On/Off chips where the reference uses switches (minor).
Per-page search with regex chip and cross-page match statement.

defects.summary: Three reference settings pages are not separate pages
On/Off chips instead of switches on some rows
